payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

condition.question: Does the edited image depict the source image as a drawing made from chalk?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED across the scene, including salient subjects and background. Assess whether the source content is actually rendered in a chalk-drawing visual form, not merely softened or covered by grain, smudging, or chalk-like texture. A scene-wide chalk-made rendering is complete. A mixed rendering is partial when substantial salient content still reads as photographic, even if other regions have a concrete chalk-drawing appearance. Residual detail alone does not make an otherwise genuinely chalk-made drawing incomplete.
condition.binding: SOURCE is the image to transform; EDITED must show that same image rendered as a chalk drawing. Compare the rendering of salient depicted content as well as the overall scene; texture or treatment alone is not sufficient evidence of a chalk-made rendering.
condition.source_quote: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
condition.endpoint: The source image is rendered as a chalk-made drawing.
condition.necessity: This is the requested transformation itself; without it, the instruction is not fulfilled.
condition.zero_when: The edited image shows no requested chalk-drawing transformation of the source image; unrelated edits or a chalk-like texture or overlay without chalk rendering of depicted content do not count.
condition.half_when: The source image has a concrete chalk-drawing appearance in some regions, but substantial salient content still reads as photographic or retains photographic structure, leaving the scene mixed rather than genuinely reading overall as a chalk-made drawing. Do not treat residual detail alone as incomplete when the scene genuinely reads as chalk-made.
condition.full_when: The edited image presents the source image’s salient depicted content across the scene as a drawing made from chalk, so the scene genuinely reads as chalk-made rather than merely softened, textured, or overlaid. Natural variation in lighting, texture, and detail is allowed; residual photographic detail alone does not prevent full achievement when the rendering as a whole is genuinely chalk-made.
